status: Source, compiled ABI and runtime audit for the optional native plain/password field adapter on one exact Firefox binary. Browser-wide native integration remains incomplete.

findings.finding: Text controls inherit ScrollContainerFrame and render anonymous contents. Theme border/background replacement alone cannot make the field editor native.
The existing engine creates an insert-text action, dispatches beforeinput, checks cancellation and uses its existing transaction batch.
Native semantic deletion commands must connect to the corresponding engine action and preserve native proposed ranges; ordinary engine geometry alone does not establish native editing behavior.
The autocomplete-style user-value path clears the read-only flag, removes maximum length and replaces the value through ReplaceTextAsAction. It is unsuitable as a generic ordinary typing adapter.
Replacement is a distinct edit action with its own beforeinput data and selection behavior; a whole-value setter cannot stand in for every native editor operation.

Native interpreted insertion/deletion proposals call real Gecko actions, preserving trusted beforeinput/input, maxlength and undo. Native proposal is then vetoed and canonical engine state echoed to avoid duplicate edits.
Reapplying unchanged setEditable restarts the native caret. Guard that setter by current native state; the real AppKit timer and existing eventfd/GLib watcher deliver browser invalidations.
Return selects the field contents in this native editor. Browser follow-up typing is compared to the direct provider result instead of an assumed selection policy.

Frame selection default handling runs after DOM listeners and before EventStateManager post handling focuses the field. Suppress that geometry only for prepared native text frames; start actual native mouse tracking after original engine focus. Engine mouseup post handling still releases capture and dispatches real clicks.

findings.source: Shared helper native control query / descriptor invalidation
findings.finding: A text operation-5 query returns the actual native bitmap without mutating the busy editor. Existing eventfd invalidations propagate native selection to the engine during a held gesture. Canonical model/focus/size changes cancel tracking before rebinding; stale native ranges cannot overwrite a different canonical engine value.

A field already using its native field editor rejects becoming first responder again. The pointer reference checks current focus before requesting it; it does not change native focus policy. Native hit testing, selection granularity, shift extension and tracking remain AppKit behavior.

remaining: Double/triple click counts, dragging selected text as data, context menus, touch and long-field horizontal/autoscroll behavior remain open beyond the qualified single-click/shift/selection-drag cases.
Browser clipboard/cut/paste events, native undo/redo menu routing, IME/composition, selection direction, multiline/rich text and accessibility.
Other text input types, native intrinsic sizing, scales other than 1, transforms and broader CSS/layout.
URL bars/frontends, Chromium text bindings, derivative-specific interfaces, other builds and remaining GTK/Qt/KDE applications.

compiled_abi.HandleDeleteSelection: Nontrivial Result return uses indirect AArch64 x8 despite small payload. Naked adapter preserves original output pointer/result. Native range applied after beforeinput only if canonical value and selection remain unchanged.
compiled_abi.retention: Real node and EditorBase AddRef/Release across layout flush, native validation and script mutations.
compiled_abi.pointer_selection: Actual nsIFrame::HandleEvent default selection boundary at 0x6e7fbdc. Native eligibility resolves through real GetNearestScrollContainerFrame(frame,3), same-document/include-hidden flags. Real SetCapturingContent(node,1,nullptr) and StopTrackingDragGesture(self,true) preserve engine capture without engine selection geometry. Capture flag 1 is verified in source and compiled MoveCaretToEventPoint call site.
